Bid Securing Declaration (BSD) in the prescribed format (Annexure-I as attached in ATC documents) will be accepted in place of EMD from the following categories: i. Bidders having satisfactorily completed a GeM contract with NIT Kurukshetra during the preceding three years with a contract value of at least ₹10 lakhs, subject to submission of suitable documentary evidence. ii. Bidders who have supplied goods/services to NIT Kurukshetra, during the preceding three years with an aggregate value of at least ₹20 lakhs, subject to satisfactory performance and submission of suitable docu mentary evidence. iii. Bidders specifically exempted from EMD/Bid Security under the applicable GFRs and GeM GTC, subject t o submission of the Bid Securing Declaration wherever permissible. . 9.
